drafts.hook_idea: Accusation: salesman slaps Kai's hand off the car
drafts.script:
SCENE 1 — INT. CAR DEALERSHIP — DAY
Kai lays his palm on the hood of a gleaming red sports car. The Car salesman slaps it away, right in his face.
CAR SALESMAN: Hands off! Kids don't touch, kids don't test drive.
Kai flinches, then squares up.
KAI: I'm here to buy it.
CAR SALESMAN: With what? Birthday money? This car costs more than your parents' house.
KAI: Give me ten minutes.
CAR SALESMAN: Take twenty. I'll be here. Selling to real customers.
He turns his back and polishes the hood where Kai touched it.

SCENE 2 — INT. CAR DEALERSHIP — WAITING BENCH — CONTINUOUS
Kai drops onto the bench by the showroom window and pulls out his phone.
★ fomo screen: Home — on Kai's phone, fills the frame
KAI: Okay. Let's go.
He taps in. The line drops.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Kai's phone, fills the frame
Kai's face falls. He holds still. Across the floor, the Car salesman smirks.
CAR SALESMAN: Bus stop's around the corner, champ.
Kai stares at the screen. Silence.
KAI: Hold. Just hold.
Quick inserts, no dialogue: Kai's thumb hovers over sell, pulls back. The wall clock jumps. His knee bounces.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Kai's phone, fills the frame
Kai's eyes go wide. A slow grin spreads.

SCENE 3 — INT. CAR DEALERSHIP — MOMENTS LATER
Kai walks straight up to the Car salesman and holds the phone up to his face.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Kai's phone, held up to the salesman's face
The Car salesman's jaw drops. He holds it.
KAI: Still only for real customers?
CAR SALESMAN: Sir! Can I get you a coffee? A test drive?
KAI: Kids don't test drive.
Kai holds out his hand.
KAI: Keys.
The salesman drops the keys into his palm. Kai slides into the driver's seat and looks to camera.
KAI: Your move. Find it on fomo.
